name: codotheca
author: Codotheca contributors
description: A library for the code you have written

scripts.build: npm run gen && npm run build:core && npm run build:app
scripts.dev: npm run gen && npm run dev --workspace app
scripts.lint: npm run lint:destructive && npm run lint:stdout && npm run lint:style && npm run lint:type && npm run lint:focus && npm run lint --workspace app && cargo clippy --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.check:bundle: node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && npm run lint:accelerators && npm run lint:updater
scripts.test: npm run gen && npm run test --workspace protocol && cargo test --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml --features testkit && npm run test --workspace app
